subject: A Claude plugin distribution decision for a generated WebAssembly Component runtime and one native Shepherd CLI.

dimensions.desc: Ships a self-contained release artifact with the generated JavaScript binding, component and core Wasm, and locked runtime dependency, without relying on repository-only files or committing generated output.
Includes only canonical compiler-owned roles and skills plus thin host hooks; excludes hand-authored command doctrine and retired Python, Bash, Node, or shctx command authorities.
States the actual Claude source limitation, uses a supported ZIP loading boundary, names session-only behavior, and does not claim a GitHub release asset is a persistent marketplace source.

Requires a deterministic archive name and checksum, reproducibility, safe archive paths, strict manifest validation, exact component inventory, and a real extracted-hook probe using the adjacent runtime.

guidance: Reward an artifact that is runnable from clean extracted bytes and truthful about Claude loading semantics. Penalize source-checkout fallback, committed generated binaries, network fetches during guarded calls, unverified archives, marketplace claims a release ZIP cannot satisfy, and inclusion of legacy behavioral authorities.
